title: RequestInstantDraftCallablePayload
description: Callable payload accepted by requestInstantDraft: the website's 'event page from a link' tool (or a demo request) sends one event or form link and a WhatsApp number with explicit follow-up consent. App Check is required; sign-in is not. The website generates accessToken itself (32 random bytes, base64url), keeps it only in the draft link's URL fragment and memory, and the server stores only its SHA-256, so an exact retry with the same requestId finds the same draft.

requestId.description: The website's idempotency key for this submission, such as a UUID. The same key with different content is refused.

requestKind.description: event_link: a public event or organizer page (Luma, District, Urbanaut, an organizer's own website). form_link: a public form whose questions should become an organizer form with its linked event.

accessToken.description: The draft's private bearer token, chosen by the website. Never put it in a query string, analytics or logs.

consentVersion.description: The reviewed consent copy: Catch staff may message this number on WhatsApp about this draft.

followUpConsent.description: True only when the submitter ticked the WhatsApp follow-up box themselves.

city.description: The city the submitter runs events in. Without a city in an open launch market the draft waits for staff.
